name: distortion-image
title: DistortionImage
description: media: WebGL2 hover-displacement image overlay (webgl, client-only, reduced motion -> static image, mobile -> plain image / 0 contexts)

item.name: distortion-image
item.summary: media: WebGL2 hover-displacement image overlay (webgl, client-only, reduced motion -> static image, mobile -> plain image / 0 contexts)

useWhen: Portfolio galleries and editorial features requiring tactile pointer distortion
Product showcases where fine-pointer interaction reveals optical depth
Media elements benefiting from fluid ripple displacement over real images
avoidWhen: Long lists of small thumbnails on mobile where static images are optimal
High-frequency rapid scrolling feeds without user hovering
Images lacking CORS headers when hosted on cross-origin domains

alternatives.name: noise-field
alternatives.when: When a generative ambient canvas background is needed instead of image distortion

tiers.0: Plain image, no WebGL (server render, prefers-reduced-motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2, or frame-guard downgrade)
tiers.1: Plain image (coarse pointer with low-end hints)
tiers.2: WebGL2 displacement overlay at DPR <= 1.5, 0.75 render scale, texture <= 1024px, only when the device reports (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine); coarse-pointer devices at this tier get the plain image
tiers.3: WebGL2 displacement overlay at DPR <= 2.0, full render scale, texture <= 2048px (fine pointer with hover)

reducedMotion.description: Renders the plain static image with no WebGL context and no animation frames.

input.pointer: Fine-pointer hover acquires a context lease and ripples around the cursor. The lease is released about 3 s after the pointer leaves or stops moving, and the render loop keeps running during that idle period (up to about 3.4 s). At most 4 contexts are live per page, shared by all instances; when the budget is full the least recently used idle image gives its slot up.
input.touch: Touch pointers fall back to the plain static image with zero WebGL allocation
input.keyboard: The wrapper is not focusable. For linked images (wrapped in <a> or containing a covering <a>), focus on the link triggers the ripple on fine-pointer devices and draws a two-tone inset focus ring above the canvas, inside the image box so parent overflow:hidden cannot clip it; exactly one tab stop is preserved. Purely decorative images have no keyboard activation. The canvas is aria-hidden

a11y.notes: The underlying HTML img element keeps the full accessible name via alt; the WebGL canvas overlay and focus ring are aria-hidden. A linked image gets exactly one tab stop (the link itself). Keyboard activation is supported whether the image is wrapped in an <a> or contains a covering <a> inside its children.

props.name: src
props.effect: Required. URL of the underlying image to display and distort.

props.name: alt
props.effect: Required. Accessible alternative text for the image.

props.name: width
props.effect: Optional. No default. Layout width of the wrapper and the img.

props.name: height
props.effect: Optional. No default. Layout height of the wrapper and the img.

props.name: strength
props.effect: Displacement ripple magnitude on hover.

props.name: speed
props.effect: Frequency and wave propagation rate during interaction.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier (0 to 3).

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop. Releases the WebGL context and shows the plain image; hover or focus does nothing until un-paused.

props.name: crossOrigin
props.effect: Optional. No default. CORS setting for the image. Only set to 'anonymous' when the host server sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers. If set on a host without CORS headers, the browser blocks the image entirely. When omitted, images from non-CORS hosts cleanly fall back to static image display without errors.

props.name: fetchPriority
props.effect: Optional. No default. Native fetchpriority attribute forwarded to the underlying img element.

props.name: fetchpriority
props.effect: Optional. No default. Lower-case alias of fetchPriority, used only when fetchPriority is not set.

props.name: loading
props.effect: Native browser image loading attribute.

props.name: decoding
props.effect: Native browser image decoding behavior.

props.name: srcSet
props.effect: Optional. No default. Native srcset. When the browser picks another candidate (resize, DPR change) the new pixels are uploaded to the texture.

props.name: sizes
props.effect: Optional. No default. Native sizes attribute for srcSet.

props.name: imgClassName
props.effect: Class names for the inner img.

props.name: imgStyle
props.effect: Optional. No default. Inline styles merged onto the inner img.

props.name: className
props.effect: Extra classes on the wrapper div. Other HTML div attributes (data-*, aria-*) are passed to the wrapper, not to the img.

props.name: style
props.effect: Optional. No default. Inline styles on the wrapper div, merged after width and height (consumer wins).

props.name: ref
props.effect:
Receives the wrapper
around the (not the itself).

props.name: onPointerEnter
props.effect: Optional. No default. Composed: called first, then the component's own handling. onPointerMove, onPointerLeave, onFocus and onBlur are composed the same way.

props.name: children
props.effect: Optional. No default. Content layered above the image and canvas, for example a caption or a link.

mistakes: Do not set crossOrigin='anonymous' unless the host server actually sends CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin); setting it on a non-CORS host causes the browser to block the image entirely. Omit it to let DistortionImage cleanly display the static image without errors.
Do not set position: absolute on the underlying img without specifying container dimensions; let the image define layout to avoid CLS.
Do not attempt to animate strength or pointer coordinates manually with requestAnimationFrame; the component handles internal interaction loops.

The wrapper is display: inline-block, set inline, so a `block` class does not override it: pass style={{ display: 'block' }} for block layout, and `w-full` / `aspect-*` classes to size it in a grid. Numeric width and height props set fixed pixels on the wrapper and the .
verify: Confirm the real img element is rendered in server HTML before hydration (CLS <= 0.01).
Confirm that when hovering with a fine pointer, a WebGL context lease is acquired and released after about 3s idle.
Confirm that coarse touch pointers and reduced-motion render the plain image with 0 WebGL contexts.
